brand.name: AVATIR

hero.heading: Digitalize caución operations in one place.
hero.subtext: AVATIR connects producers, operations teams, and insurers in a single platform to manage surety requests, documentation, approvals, and policy issuance — starting with a focused MVP built for speed and future scale.

aboutUs.title: Built for surety operations teams
aboutUs.body: AVATIR centralizes surety requests, documents, and policy emissions instead of juggling spreadsheets and email threads, giving operations, producers, and insurers one shared source of truth.

benefits.centralize: Centralize surety requests, documents, and policy emissions instead of juggling spreadsheets and email threads.
benefits.workflow: Run each request through a structured workflow — from draft to review, approval, and issuance — with full status history.
benefits.partners: Manage producers, companies, and portfolio relationships with role-based access and commercial portfolio protection.
benefits.traceability: Keep complete traceability with change history, comments, approvals, rejections, and basic access audit.

contract.title: SURETY BOND INSURANCE TEMPLATE CONTRACT
contract.subtitle: Template document generated from the AVATIR simulation. It does not constitute an issued policy or active coverage until formal approval and issuance.
contract.objectBody: This template contract is intended to guarantee the Obligor’s obligations toward the Beneficiary, under the simulated surety terms and the particular conditions agreed upon final issuance.

clauses.scope: The guarantee is limited to the stated coverage amount and the bond type selected in the simulation.
clauses.premium: The estimated premium is indicative and may change after risk assessment, documentation review, and issuance terms.
clauses.term: Coverage start and end dates will be set in the final policy, using the simulated term as a reference.
clauses.claims: In the event of a claim, the Beneficiary must notify non-performance according to the procedure set in the issued policy.
clauses.nonBinding: This document is a simulation template and creates no rights or obligations until a formal policy is issued.

contract.disclaimer: AVATIR generates this template for operational and quotation purposes only. Final issuance requires review, approval, and complete documentation.
